extraction: pdftotext -layout; unmodified Table S6 excerpt; parse integer death-count triples with extract_table_s6.py
precision: Published model estimates rounded by the authors (three significant digits), not individual observed deaths.
aggregation: Use published All Causes total and its UI. Components retained for audit, never add their UI limits.
covid_shading: Annual estimates for 2020 and 2021, represented by year bins 2019.5 to 2021.5. This does not define daily pandemic boundaries.
